reason: I already own a good reusable bottle; my problem is forgetting it, not what's in it, and a filter doesn't fix that. Paying $68 up front or $63 for the bottle alone to solve a problem I don't really have isn't worth it on my budget.
objection: It's another subscription I'll forget to cancel, and $50 for a bottle plus $13 shipping feels steep when tap water at the gym fountain is fine and my current bottle works.
would_change_my_mind: A one-time bottle with filters I can buy whenever I want, no plan, around $30 shipped, and some proof the filter actually makes a difference over regular tap water.
